title: Applied AI Engineer roadmap
summary: A focused pathway to LLM integration, prompt engineering, retrieval, and product shipping. By The end you’ll have A portfolio and be ready for AI-focused roles.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Solidify core programming and API fundamentals.

milestones.title: Choose Python or TypeScript
milestones.outcome: Write clean scripts and web-service code without syntax errors.

tasks.title: Complete Python basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Finish the introductory Python module covering variables, loops, and functions.

tasks.title: Build a CLI calculator in Python
tasks.description: Implement add, subtract, multiply, divide with argparse for input parsing.

tasks.title: Review TypeScript types on MDN
tasks.description: Read the TypeScript type system overview and note differences from JavaScript.

tasks.title: Convert the CLI calculator to TypeScript
tasks.description: Rewrite the Python script using Node.js and TypeScript, ensuring type safety.

milestones.title: API interaction basics
milestones.outcome: Make authenticated HTTP requests and handle JSON responses.

tasks.title: Read MDN fetch guide
tasks.description: Study how to use fetch/axios for GET and POST requests.

tasks.title: Call OpenAI chat completion endpoint
tasks.description: Write a script that sends a prompt and prints the response, using your API key securely.

tasks.title: Handle rate-limit errors
tasks.description: Add exponential backoff logic to the script and test with forced errors.

tasks.title: Document API usage in README
tasks.description: Create concise documentation for future reuse of the script.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Learn prompt design, retrieval, evaluation, and web-app shipping.

milestones.title: Create effective prompts
milestones.outcome: Craft effective prompts and iterate using systematic techniques.

tasks.title: Study OpenAI prompt design guide
tasks.description: Read the official best-practice article and note three key techniques.

tasks.title: Create 5 prompt variants for a Q&A task
tasks.description: Write prompts that differ in instruction style, temperature, and examples.

tasks.title: Run each variant through the API
tasks.description: Collect responses and compare relevance using a simple rubric.

tasks.title: Summarize findings in a table
tasks.description: Document which techniques improved answer quality and why.

milestones.title: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
milestones.outcome: Integrate vector stores and retrieve relevant documents for LLM prompting.

tasks.title: Watch Pinecone intro on YouTube
tasks.description: Understand vector embeddings, indexing, and similarity search concepts.

tasks.title: Generate embeddings with OpenAI embeddings API
tasks.description: Write a script that converts a set of PDFs to embeddings and stores them locally.

tasks.title: Implement a simple similarity search
tasks.description: Given a user query, retrieve the top-3 most similar chunks and prepend them to the prompt.

tasks.title: Test retrieval on a sample document set
tasks.description: Verify that retrieved chunks improve answer relevance compared to baseline.

tasks.title: Reflect on failure cases
tasks.description: Note situations where retrieval hurts performance and hypothesize reasons.

milestones.title: Evaluation techniques
milestones.outcome: Design and run automated tests for prompts and LLM outputs.

tasks.title: Read evaluation section of LLMOps guide on GitHub
tasks.description: Identify common metrics like relevance, factuality, and latency.

tasks.title: Write a script to compute BLEU for generated answers
tasks.description: Use the nltk library to compare model output against a reference set.

tasks.title: Create a prompt-performance dashboard
tasks.description: Log metrics to a CSV and generate a simple Matplotlib chart.

tasks.title: Run the dashboard on 10 prompt variants
tasks.description: Collect data and identify the best-performing prompt.

tasks.title: Document evaluation methodology
tasks.description: Write a brief guide for future projects to replicate the process.

milestones.title: Shipping web apps
milestones.outcome: Deploy a full-stack AI-powered web service.

tasks.title: Follow freeCodeCamp full-stack project tutorial
tasks.description: Build a Node/Express backend with a React frontend.

tasks.title: Add LLM endpoint to the backend
tasks.description: Expose a POST route that forwards user input to the OpenAI API and returns the response.

tasks.title: Implement basic auth with JWT
tasks.description: Secure the endpoint so only logged-in users can call the model.

tasks.title: Deploy to Render free tier
tasks.description: Create a Render service, push code via Git, and verify live operation.

tasks.title: Write a post-mortem note
tasks.description: Summarize deployment steps, challenges, and next improvements.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that showcase end-to-end AI solutions.

milestones.title: Document Q&A app with citations
milestones.outcome: Demonstrate RAG, prompt design, and web deployment in a single product.

tasks.title: Outline app architecture on a whiteboard
tasks.description: Define data flow from upload to answer generation with citations.

tasks.title: Implement document ingestion pipeline
tasks.description: Parse PDFs, chunk text, generate embeddings, and store in Pinecone.

tasks.title: Add citation extraction logic
tasks.description: Parse model output to identify source chunk IDs and display links.

tasks.title: Write a 2-minute demo video script
tasks.description: Explain problem, solution, and key technical choices concisely.

tasks.title: Publish repo and video on GitHub
tasks.description: Create a README, add screenshots, and link the demo video.

milestones.title: AI agent with tool use
milestones.outcome: Show ability to orchestrate multiple APIs through an LLM-driven planner.

tasks.title: Design agent workflow diagram
tasks.description: Map steps: user intent → tool selection → API call → response aggregation.

tasks.title: Code tool-selection prompt
tasks.description: Create a prompt that decides which external API (e.g., weather, calculator) to invoke.

tasks.title: Integrate two sample tools (weather API, calculator)
tasks.description: Write wrappers that the agent can call and return structured results.

tasks.title: Test agent on 5 real-world scenarios
tasks.description: Run end-to-end queries and note success/failure cases.

tasks.title: Add the project to your portfolio site
tasks.description: Create a project page with description, tech stack, and live demo link.

milestones.title: Prompt evaluation harness
milestones.outcome: Provide a reusable framework to benchmark prompts across models.

tasks.title: Sketch evaluation framework schema
tasks.description: Define inputs, metrics, and result storage format (JSON).

tasks.title: Implement harness in Python
tasks.description: Create a CLI that runs a list of prompts against selected LLMs and logs metrics.

tasks.title: Add support for OpenAI and Anthropic APIs
tasks.description: Abstract API calls behind a common interface for easy swapping.

tasks.title: Run benchmark on 3 prompt sets
tasks.description: Generate a comparative report showing strengths of each model.

tasks.title: Share the repo and write a blog post
tasks.description: Explain why systematic evaluation matters and link to the code.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Advance topics, interview prep, and professional positioning.

milestones.title: Advanced LLM techniques
milestones.outcome: Apply fine-tuning, function calling, and multi-modal inputs.

tasks.title: Read OpenAI function calling docs
tasks.description: Understand JSON schema definition and response parsing.

tasks.title: Add function calling to the Q&A app
tasks.description: Enable the model to request citation data via a defined function.

tasks.title: Experiment with OpenAI fine-tuning guide
tasks.description: Create a small dataset and submit a fine-tune job (free tier).

tasks.title: Summarize trade-offs in a one-page note
tasks.description: Compare zero-shot, function calling, and fine-tuned approaches.

milestones.title: Interview and client readiness
milestones.outcome: Confidently discuss projects, solve whiteboard problems, and pitch AI solutions.

tasks.title: Write STAR stories for each portfolio project
tasks.description: Structure Situation, Task, Action, Result for concise storytelling.

tasks.title: Practice system design interview on Pramp
tasks.description: Run at least one mock session focusing on AI-centric architectures.

tasks.title: Create a one-page technical resume
tasks.description: Highlight key skills, projects, and measurable impacts.

tasks.title: Reach out to 3 AI community members on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Share your portfolio and ask for feedback or referrals.

milestones.title: Continuous learning pipeline
milestones.outcome: Stay current with emerging models and evaluation standards.

tasks.title: Subscribe to the LLM-Ops newsletter
tasks.description: Set up weekly email digest of new papers and tools.

tasks.title: Schedule monthly Kaggle micro-challenge
tasks.description: Pick a small dataset, apply an LLM, and post results publicly.

tasks.title: Update evaluation harness with new metrics
tasks.description: Add hallucination detection using a simple fact-check API.

tasks.title: Write a quarterly blog recap
tasks.description: Summarize what you learned, experiments run, and next steps.
